calculator_engine: function epf(basic,currentAge,retAge,existing,rate){const n=(retAge-currentAge)*12;const empContrib=basic*0.12;const erContrib=basic*0.0367;const total=empContrib+erContrib;const r=rate/100/12;const fv=total*(Math.pow(1+r,n)-1)/r+existing*Math.pow(1+r,n);return{corpus:fv,empTotal:empContrib*n,erTotal:erContrib*n,interest:fv-total*n-existing};}
